newsitem.title: GERMANY: German unemployment declined further in May - Bild.
newsitem.headline: German unemployment declined further in May - Bild.

text.p: The number of German jobless, before seasonal adjustment, declined by 91,000 in May to 4.255 million, the Bild newspaper reported, citing data from the Federal Labour Office.
The unemployment rate declined to an unadjusted 11.06 percent from 11.3 percent, Bild said in advance excerpts of a story from its Thursday edition.
The office is due to release the May employment data on Friday. The figures could not be immediately confirmed.
In April, unadjusted unemployment declined to 4.347 million from 4.477 million the previous month, but adjusted unemployment rose 8,000 to 4.299 million.
